title: One email, sent by hand via Send reminder; nothing sends automatically in v1
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit customers, on the build under test.
  2. A customer whose 'Send preventive maintenance notifications' setting is ON, with an asset that has a preferred contact carrying an email address (e.g. customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co', unit 'Truck 12', contact 'Dave Brabay').
  3. The asset has one or more services currently inside their reminder window. Open the asset's contact card.
custom_steps:
1. On the contact card, use Send reminder for one asset.
  2. Confirm there is no automatic/scheduled sending anywhere in v1.
  3. Confirm every message v1 sends goes to a customer (there is no internal email).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • One email exists; Send reminder on the contact card sends it for one asset.
  • Nothing sends it automatically in v1 (automatic sending is deferred to v2).
  • There is no internal email - every message v1 sends goes to a customer.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S19; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S19-N5: “There is no internal email. Every message v1 sends goes to a customer”
